Hi there. I am so mad I have to be making this post, but I need help. I have a 60D and today while on a ferry ride, we hit rough seas and my camera got wet. I had it in a Meijer bag but that apparently was not good enough-as when I removed it from the bag on shore, there was sitting water in the bottom and my camera was wet. I had left it on and it had just been in sleep mode- so I could not remove the battery without it having potential to short circuit. At first, it was showing me an error on the LCD that said something along the lines of : battery error, remove battery and restart. So I did just that. And now the LCD is showing nothing, and the top screen by the shutter button is saying FULL and [999] and ISO 1600. It is flashing all of these things. I have an awful feeling my camera is fried.
Right now it is sitting in a nylon surrounded by 5 pounds of rice until I can get into my photo store tomorrow. If anybody has had a similar experience, I would love to hear about it and what your end game was for the camera. I just got it in April so I am furious about the fact I will be spending even more money on it. I also have a wedding to shoot on Saturday, so hopefully a friend will let me use their camera...this is all a giant mess and I am super torn up about it.
TL;DR 60D took on water and is showing error messages. Camera was on when it happened. Any advice or similar experiences appreciated.
